messages:
maria: Hello team — starting on-call next week and I want to get my ducks in a row. Two quick things: I don't have PagerDuty access yet, and I want to join an incident sim. Who should I poke for quick access?

ravi: Hi @maria, I can add you to PD right now. Check your inbox for the invite and verify mobile push. If you don't get it within 10m reply here and I'll resend.

noah: For sims we use a signup sheet (internal). Link is https://go/rw-oncall-sims. Pick a slot and add your GitHub handle. Newbies: try the "dev reenact" before the sim so the flow feels natural.

maria: Thanks. Any lightweight pre-shadow checklist you recommend so I don't block the session?

kim: Quick pre-shadow checklist I hand out:
1) Accept PD invite, enable mobile + test with a low-priority alert.
2) Confirm read-only runbook access and read the shadow checklist.
3) Run the dev reenact (one liner below).
4) Skim two recent postmortems for format and comms style.

kim: Dev reenact snippet from runbooks:
```bash
# dev reenact: trigger an alert in dev namespace
kubectl apply -f tools/load-gen.yaml -n dev-reenact
sleep 15
# watch logs to confirm alert path
kubectl logs -f deploy/load-gen -n dev-reenact
```

ravi: If you still need vault read permissions for the shadow, file infra-access with reason "oncall-shadow" and tag me. I can fast-track read-only. Reminder: do NOT use prod creds during sims.

ops-coordinator: @maria added to shadow cohort week starting 2026-07-06. Assigned buddy: kim. Reserved sim slot Tue 2026-07-07 14:00-15:00. Please finish the orientation checklist before your slot: https://go/rw-oncall-checklist

maria: Great, one run-time question: if I get a page while shadowing, what's the expected rough timeline for escalation? Short bullets are perfect.

noah: TL;DR escalation:
- 0-15m: Own first response 1 ack the page in PD, gather context, post short update in #incidents.
- 15-30m: If unresolved, notify secondary on PD and ping @oncall-lead in the channel.
- 30-60m: If impact is severe (P1) or customer-facing, call on-call lead and open incident channel with template.
- After: assign postmortem owner within 48h and add actions to the tracker.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll try the reenact tonight and sign up for the sim. If PD invite doesn't show up I'll ping @ravi here.

oncall-bot: Rotation updated: maria added to PagerDuty rotation week starting 2026-07-06. Notifications sent to: maria, kim, ravi.
